claim_policy: This is a retrospective tradable-proxy study, not a live or prospective track record.
QUAL is not a literal CMA portfolio and ETF returns cannot replicate academic long-short factor portfolios exactly.
Report every locked cost case and benchmark, including underperformance.
Do not use the result as a recommendation to invest personal money.

locked_data_and_execution.rebalance_frequency: monthly at the last available trading-day close
locked_data_and_execution.source: Yahoo Finance adjusted total-return history through yfinance
locked_data_and_execution.weights: constant target weights from the already-frozen profitable-factor allocation

QUAL.role: US quality/profitability proxy; imperfectly absorbs the conservative-investment weight

locked_windows.post_freeze_extension: 2026-01-01 through latest complete month, reported separately if available

motivation: Academic Fama-French factor returns are not directly investable.
This study translates the previously fixed factor weights into a simple long-only ETF basket that can be paper traded without leverage or shorting.
The mapping and evaluation rules were written before ETF return outcomes were downloaded for this extension.
